All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
BasicWindow
BasicWindow abstract class is used as parent of all windows in projects.
Board
Board class is used to control all cells in game board based on game rules.
BoardDifficulties
BoardDifficulties class represents all constant paths to .json files.
BoardPanel
BoardPanel class represents panel where main game board is shown.
BoardWindow
BoardWindow class is used for showing user a board in stats.
Cell
Cell class represents cell in board with its type, icon, sound, etc.
CellTypes
CellTypes enum is used to assign type for special cell.
Data
Data abstract class is used as parent of all data classes.
Difficulty
Difficulty enum is used to assign chosen difficulty to a board.
DifficultyPanel
DifficultyPanel class represents panel where user can choose difficulty of the board.
EndPanel
EndPanel class is used to show player if he loosed or won.
Game
Game class represents the whole game mechanism.
GameData
GameData class represents all data that was used in a game.
GamePanel
GamePanel class is used for showing side things such as flags left and time.
GameWindow
GameWindow class represents the whole game and also all panels used in it.
Images
Images class represents all constant images loaded from paths.
IntroducingPanel
IntroducingPanel class represents main menu panel that user first see when opens app.
IntroducingWindow
IntroducingWindow class represents main menu window with all panels provided.
Main
 
MainMenuMusic
MainMenuMusic enum is used for selecting menu music by player.
MyColor
This class represents color in game for .json files to be converted into Color objects.
MyMouseAdapter
MyMouseAdapter class controls user mouse action in game.
Player
Player class represents player in game with its parameters.
RandomGen
This class is used solving all problems with random generation.
SettingsData
SettingsData class represents all data of settings in introducing window.
SettingsPanel
SettingsPanel class represents panel where player can set values of the game for better experience.
SimpleButton
SimpleButton class represents button pre-built for better code logic.
SimpleLabel
SimpleLabel class represents label pre-built for better code logic.
SoundPlayer
SoundPlayer class is used for playing all sounds used in game.
Sounds
Sounds class is used to provide paths to all sounds in game.
StatsPanel
StatsPanel represents panel where all stats of the game is shown.
Value
Value class represents value of cell with it number and color.
